g.title: Cyanohydrin formation event 1
g.desc: PhCHO + CN⁻ → PhCH(O⁻)CN Cyanide carbon → benzaldehyde C; C=O π pair → O. Both carbonyl faces are possible.

g.text: Cyanide carbon → benzaldehyde C; C=O π pair → O. Both carbonyl faces are possible.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.

g.title: Cyanohydrin formation event 2
g.desc: PhCH(O⁻)CN + HCN → PhCH(OH)CN + CN⁻ Alkoxide O → H of HCN; H–C pair → cyanide C. No enantiomer is selected.

g.text: Alkoxide O → H of HCN; H–C pair → cyanide C. No enantiomer is selected.
Original structural mechanism · 2-electron curved arrows · 2D depiction, not a calculated trajectory.
